name: Grand Hyatt Mumbai
positioning: Grand Hyatt Mumbai Hotel & Residences: a hotel with serviced apartments set across 12 acres of landscaped gardens in Santacruz, minutes from the airport
best_for: Travelers who want a garden setting close to the airport and BKC
Long-stay guests wanting a serviced apartment with a fully equipped kitchen

facts.text: Grand Hyatt Mumbai is set across 12 acres of landscaped gardens in Santacruz.
The Nita Mukesh Ambani Cultural Centre and Jio World Drive are in nearby BKC.
Courtyard View rooms look out over the hotel's courtyard.
The serviced apartments have fully equipped kitchens for short and extended stays.
The Presidential Suite includes butler service.
The Grand Club lounge is open to Club room and suite guests.
The Grand Club offers private breakfast, high tea and cocktail hours.
The pool has a dedicated poolside bar.
The Club Oasis Fitness Centre has a fully equipped gym and personal trainers.
China House has served Sichuan cuisine in Mumbai for over two decades.
LOOKS Salon at the hotel offers hair, beauty, nail and grooming services.

highlights.text: The Verandah Suite has an expansive private verandah with views of the hotel's green landscapes and the Mumbai skyline.
Every serviced apartment at Grand Hyatt Mumbai Residences has access to a private swimming pool area and its own entry and lobby.
An outdoor pool and a children's pool are on the banquet level.
Club Oasis, the spa on the banquet level, offers spa treatments designed to rejuvenate.
The Magic Table is a dinner experience by mentalists Thommy Ten and Amelie van Tass, with immersive 3D projections, illusion and a five-course dinner.

considerations.text: A taxi to the international airport's Terminal 2 takes about 15 to 25 minutes, depending on traffic.
Children under 16 and pets are not allowed in the Grand Club.
WhataHotel notes the business-focused location may lack tourist attractions nearby.
